295:t_016:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「W-wait! You can't just say that out of nowhere...!」

295:t_016:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Then trust me. I have no intention of lying.」

295:t_016:8.en:
$$シャア$$
「Right now, taking down that $$尸空#pilot$$ comes first. But all units, do not let your guard down.」

295:t_016:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You're all no different from me in the end. People branded with the $$烙印$$...」

295:t_016:12.en:
$$ランド$$
「I don't have time to play along with your poetry! I've got a man even gloomier than you to deal with over here!」

295:t_016:13.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$アサキム$$... I'll set our reckoning aside for now.」

295:t_016:15.en:
$$万丈$$
「Here I come, $$サイデリアル$$! On this Mars, I swear to win!」

295:t_017:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You can take it that way.」

295:t_017:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I'm not fool enough to fight seven $$スフィア$$s at once.」

295:t_018:0.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「So this is as far as it goes.」

295:t_018:2.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You can take it that way.」

295:t_018:4.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I'm not fool enough to fight seven $$スフィア$$s at once.」

295:t_020:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Don't chase him, $$アサキム$$. There's no need to rush a settlement here.」

295:t_021:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have no more business here.」

295:t_021:2.en:
$$ランド$$
「Did it bother you that much to be sealed inside $$ＺＯＮＥ$$!?」

295:t_021:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...Not really. I thought that falling into an eternal sleep as we were would have been best for me and for you all.」

295:t_021:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But if I've been woken from that sleep, I'll struggle. Ugly, shameless... and graceless.」

295:t_022:0.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...He does tend to be far too single-minded.」

295:t_022:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Advent... Did you free $$アサキム$$ from $$ＺＯＮＥ$$?」

295:t_022:2.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No. But there was a connection, and I ended up acting together with him.」

295:t_022:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Did you take $$アサキム$$ into $$クロノ$$'s reformist faction?」

295:t_022:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You are welcome to think so.」

295:t_022:5.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Before that, why are you alive?」

295:t_022:6.en:
$$オズマ$$
「You should have died in the battle with $$ガドライト#pilot$$...」

295:t_022:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Does it displease you that I'm alive?」

295:t_022:9.en:
$$甲児$$
「We've been burned before by a guy who played dead.」

295:t_022:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「You mean the $$偽りの黒羊$$, $$アイム・ライアード$$... True, the reason I'm alive is probably something close to the power of his $$スフィア$$.」

295:t_022:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「No, Miss $$スズネ$$. I only ever speak the truth.」

295:t_022:13.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n... You understand that, don't you?」

295:t_022:15.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I apologize for not telling you I was alive. ...But you will believe me, won't you?」

295:t_022:17.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Look me in the eyes, $n.」

295:t_022:19.en:
$n
「More than anything, I'm just happy you're alive...」

295:t_023:0.en:
$$ブルー$$
「...My apologies, Captain. I lost sight of $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$.」

295:t_023:1.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Don't worry, $$ブルー$$. His path and mine lead to the same place, so sooner or later he will return to us.」

295:t_023:3.en:
$$ブルー$$
「It's been a long time, $$メール$$. And $$ランド$$ and $$セツコ$$ as well.」

295:t_023:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Did you know Advent was alive?」

295:t_023:5.en:
$$ブルー$$
「I apologize. At the time we made contact with you, even we did not yet know that fact.」

295:t_023:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「When we were about to get caught up in $$アマルガム$$'s $$時空震動弾$$ in $$第２新東京市$$, you all appeared, but...」

295:t_023:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「That was on my orders. I tried to suppress the spacequake, but the result is what you all know.」

295:t_023:10.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I'm sorry. There is still something I must do.」

295:t_023:11.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「But someday, I will fight alongside you. Because your path and mine lead to the same place.」

295:t_023:12.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Until we meet again, $n. I await the day you overcome hope and despair.」

295:t_024:1.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Everything about him is a mystery.」

295:t_024:2.en:
$$カイエン$$
「Being told to trust a man like that...」

295:t_024:3.en:
$$シュレード$$
「Cut it out, pal. Think about how $n feels, too.」

295:t_024:5.en:
$n
「No, it's all right... I haven't managed to digest the fact that Advent is alive myself...」

295:t_024:6.en:
$n
「Of course I'm glad he's alive, but...」

295:t_024:8.en:
$$モニカ$$
「Captain...! A ship is approaching us!」

295:t_025:0.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I came following $$ブルー$$'s guidance, and this sure is a surprise...」
